info.name: MANDATE - Financial Authorization & Security Gateway API
info.description: Complete Postman test suite for MANDATE (PayPal AI Hackathon 2026). Includes all core routes, 4 demonstration test scenarios, simulation mode, policy engine tests, and human approvals.

request.description: Calculates real-time financial metrics: captured spending, reserved funds, available budget, and blocked attempted value.

item.name: Compile Natural Language Prompt into Mandate (Gemini)

request.description: Submits an informal natural language prompt to Gemini Flash model cascade to compile structured financial rules.
Retrieves all spending policies owned by the authenticated user tenant.
Fetches current spending bounds, limits, and merchant whitelists for a specific mandate.
Returns immutable version history and spending limit change snapshots for the mandate.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Studio Equipment Mandate",
  "description": "Procure studio lighting and backdrop accessories under $250.",
  "currency": "USD",
  "totalBudget": 250.00,
  "maxTransactionAmount": 150.00,
  "maxQuantityPerPurchase": 1,
  "approvedMerchants": ["Apex Optics", "B&H Photo Video"],
  "blockedMerchants": ["ShadyReseller Store"],
  "allowedCategories": ["Photography Accessories", "Studio Gear"],
  "restrictedCategories": ["Weapons", "Gambling"],
  "approvalRequiredCategories": ["Electronics"],
  "allowUnknownMerchants": false,
  "requiresHumanApproval": false,
  "approvalThreshold": 100.00,
  "expiryDays": 30
}

request.description: Directly registers a structured spending policy.
Pauses an active mandate, causing all subsequent agent proposals to be strictly BLOCKED.
Tests hypothetical transactions against policy rules without altering budgets or calling PayPal. Scenarios: within_budget, over_budget, unapproved_merchant, requires_approval, expired_mandate.

request.description: Tests server-side schema validation against invalid input.
Lists all policy exceptions currently awaiting human review.
Authorizes the transaction exception and generates the PayPal Sandbox Order.
Rejects the transaction exception, releasing all in-flight reserved budget back to the mandate.
Captures the PayPal Sandbox payment on the server. Requires buyer to have approved the order on PayPal Checkout. Returns 422 if buyer has not yet approved.
Asynchronous webhook receiver for PayPal payment capture events with duplicate delivery prevention.
Queries Channel3 live commerce API to return structured multi-retailer product offers.

item.name: Reset Demonstration State to Baseline Seed

request.description: Wipes transaction history and restores clean $100 budget and baseline seed mandate.
